verdict.rationale: three.js publishes an llms.txt/llms-full.txt specifically to let AI coding agents generate code that drives the library, which is a step toward AI-native operability, but there is no natural-language command interface, chat layer, or MCP server that lets a user directly 'command' the renderer in natural language — an agent still has to write and run JavaScript. Missing for 10: a direct natural-language control layer, an MCP server or agent API, and independent evidence of agents successfully operating three.js purely via NL commands.
